name: dns-multiple-excluded-disjoint-first-invalid
description: Multiple excluded dNSName subtrees of the same type form a union. The CA excludes bad.example.com and evil.example.net; the leaf is under the first excluded subtree, so the chain must be rejected. This catches implementations that overwrite earlier same-type excluded entries with later entries.
notes: Pair with dns-multiple-excluded-disjoint-second-invalid. Together they catch first-entry-wins and last-entry-wins storage bugs in per-name-form excluded subtree state.
